questions.q: Identify the error: The table's legs / have been / elaborately carved / No Error.
questions.s: Non-living things ke saath apostrophe 's' avoid karte hain. 'The legs of the table' sahi structure hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: All his sister-in-laws / are extremely beautiful / to look at so the question / of selection is very confusing.
o: to look at so the question
questions.s: Bhai, root word pakdo! Plural 'Sisters-in-law' hoga, 'Sister-in-laws' nahi.

questions.q: Whenever he goes to Mumbai / he stays in / five-stars hotels / No Error.
questions.s: Hyphenated Adjective rule! Jab Noun adjective ki tarah kaam kare (hyphen ke baad), toh wo singular rehta hai. 'Five-star hotels' sahi hai.

questions.q: The police / has received / two important informations / that can help them solve the murder case.
o: that can help them solve the murder case
questions.s: Police plural collective noun hai, iske saath Verb plural 'Have' aayegi. Aur 'Information' bhi singular hoga. Double error!

questions.q: Identify the error: All the / chiefs ministers / are responsible for / the pitiable condition of their states.
o: the pitiable condition of their states
questions.s: Compound Noun pluralization! Main word 'Minister' hai. Sahi plural: 'Chief Ministers'.

questions.q: Identify the error: The population of India / is divided into / two classes- Haves and Haves not / No Error.
o: two classes- Haves and Haves not
questions.s: Phrase error! Sahi phrase 'Haves and Have-nots' (ameer aur gareeb) hota hai.

questions.q: I went to the temple / with my parents, aunts / and cousin sisters / No Error.
questions.s: Superfluous error! 'Cousin' ke saath Brother/Sister nahi lagate. Bas 'Cousins' bolo.

questions.q: Identify the error: He was advised to take / two spoonsful of / medicine times a day / No Error.
questions.s: Spelling error! Sahi plural 'Spoonfuls' hota hai, 'Spoonsful' nahi.

questions.q: The Billy goat gave birth to a kid.
questions.s: Dhyaan se dekho! 'Billy goat' Male hota hai, wo birth nahi de sakta. Female goat ko 'Nanny goat' kehte hain. Sahi sentence: 'The Nanny goat gave birth...'.

questions.q: Lalu Yadav has nine offsprings still he faces no problem in providing them food.
o: no problem in providing them food
questions.s: Exam mein examiner yahan confuse karta hai. 'Offspring' (santan) ka plural nahi banta. 'Offsprings' galat word hai, 'Offspring' hi use karein.

questions.q: My sister / has read / pages after pages / of the Bible.
questions.s: Ye concept bahut important hai. Jab Noun + Preposition + Same Noun ho, toh Noun singular rehta hai. 'Page after page' sahi hoga.

questions.q: The company has decided to recruit a large number of employee to work in its new branch.
o: to recruit a large number of employee
to work in its new branch.
questions.s: Ratta mat maaro, concept samjho. 'A large number of' ke baad Noun hamesha Plural aata hai. 'Employee' nahi 'Employees' hoga.

questions.q: Kapil dev said that Sachin's and Sehwag's partnership was very impressive.
questions.s: Joint Possession ka rule hai. Jab partnership dono ki ek hi hai, toh apostrophe sirf baad wale naam pe lagega: 'Sachin and Sehwag's partnership'.

questions.q: She wears spectacle / and so she was unable / to see the gangster / that attacked her.
questions.s: Common mistake! Chashme ko 'Spectacles' (plural) bolte hain. 'Spectacle' ka matlab nazara hota hai.

questions.q: The scenery of Kashmir is very charming.
questions.s: SSC CGL ka favorite pattern. 'Scenery' uncountable hai, iska plural nahi banta aur verb singular hoti hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: One of her firmest belief / was that her friend shouted at her / with a view to making her / aware of her repeated lapses.
o: was that her friend shouted at her
with a view to making her
questions.s: Rule yaad hai na? 'One of' ke baad Noun Plural hota hai. 'One of her firmest beliefs' aayega.

questions.q: Identify the error: He gave me / two important informations / I had been waiting for / the previous two months.
questions.s: Bhai, ye plural nahi hota! 'Information' uncountable hai. Count karne ke liye 'Two pieces of information' bolo.

questions.q: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error: An ellipse has two focus and a circle has only one centre.
questions.s: Singular-Plural ka khel hai. 'Focus' singular hai. Iska plural 'Foci' hota hai. 'Two Foci' sahi hoga.

questions.q: Identify the error: The beautiful / advices given by / my mother are / valuable.
questions.s: Galti pakad mein aayi? 'Advice' uncountable hai, 's' nahi lagega. 'The beautiful advice' sahi hai.

questions.q: Select the correct collective noun: A ______ of arrows.
questions.s: Arrows (teer) ke group/container ko 'Quiver' kehte hain. Note kar lo.

questions.q: Envy strikes a woman / when she sees her husband / talking to another woman / No Error.
questions.s: Confusing words! Apni cheez khone ka darr 'Jealousy' hota hai, dusre ki cheez dekhkar jalna 'Envy' hota hai. Yahan 'Jealousy' aayega.

questions.q: Identify the error: The cattle / in the meadow / was terrified to hear / the roar of a lion.
questions.s: SSC CGL favorite! 'Cattle' plural noun hai. Verb 'Were' aayegi, 'Was' nahi.

questions.q: The Indian independence movement sought to establish the 'conceptions of freedom' and social welfare.
questions.s: Context ke hisaab se 'Concepts of Liberty' sahi hai. Political context mein 'Liberty' word zyada appropriate hai.

questions.q: Drinking tea is a English 'habit.'
questions.s: Simple sa rule hai. Individual ki 'Habit' hoti hai, lekin Society/Country ka 'Custom' (rivaaz) hota hai.

questions.q: Radha bought a sheet of paper from the stationary and wrote something on it.
o: Radha bought a sheet of paper
questions.s: Spelling error hai bhai! 'Stationary' ka matlab 'sthir' (not moving) hota hai. Pen/Paper wali dukaan ko 'Stationery' ('e' ke saath) kehte hain.
